exceptions.reason: oh-my-pi 17.0.5 remaps @earendil-works/pi-ai onto @oh-my-pi/pi-ai. That package has no root isModelType export, no ./compat, and no ./api/typesafe-system-one.lazy. omlx statically imports isModelType and @earendil-works/pi-ai/compat, and registers with Pi's object-form registerProvider(Provider). omp registerProvider is (name, ProviderConfig) only. omp ProviderConfig has no refreshModels or classifier field, and its apiKey is a string, not Pi's auth.apiKey login/check/resolve object; its only dynamic-model hook is fetchDynamicModels(apiKey).
